checkpoints.at: the certificate question, decided from the record and the source rather than from the finding
checkpoints.what: Extracted the printed text of AOC-275.18 through the build's own extractTextItems/groupIntoLines, and read every service-related node of the record.
checkpoints.result: The form prints no certificate of service anywhere. What it prints is the clerk's own distribution list ('Copies to: Court file / Petitioner / Respondent') inside the NOTIFICATION OF EXPUNGEMENT HEARING block, above '_____ Clerk' and 'By: _____ D.C.'. The record binds one binary and names one other form, AOC-275.19, which was never retrieved and is itself a release blocker. Building a certificate would need that missing form plus the petitioner's name and address, the clerk-set hearing date and the mailing date — none of which is held. STOP, not invention. The build now asserts the 'no form' half at build time so the question is re-decided if the form ever changes.
